page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9i.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance configured with 24 dedicated vCPUs and 96.0 GB of system memory. Powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this instance utilizes KVM virtualization to deliver dedicated compute resources. The hardware configuration establishes a balanced 1:4 ratio of vCPUs to memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 15 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a standard resource density profile offers a predictable performance baseline for workloads that do not require specialized hardware accelerators or local NVMe storage.

Given the balanced compute-to-memory ratio and dedicated processor allocation, the ecs.g9i.6xlarge is suited for general-purpose workloads. These include web serving, application servers, enterprise applications, and medium-sized databases that rely on network-attached storage.
